managing under the national data sharing policy.
Anyone interested to use the data sets could
communicate to the Ethiopian Public Health
institute, National Data Management Centrer using
the following link: https://rtds.ephi.gov.et/public/
showdetail/94#step-1. The data can be accessed
using following URLs: ESPA+ 2014 (https://rtds.
ephi.gov.et/public/showdetail/76), SARA 2016
(https://rtds.ephi.gov.et/public/showdetail/93) and
